answer_4.quote: We recruited 37 English-speaking participants, 31 of whom participated in our study... We recruited three of the experts from Section 2 to evaluate these transcripts.
answer_4.guideline: Participants assessed agents via Likert scales for CUQ, WAI, CEMI, and SMART questions; experts annotated transcripts based on six insights (I1-I6).
